metas.name: Shomoukh Al-Mazen
metas.description: On an ordinary day in the desert (the Badia), two baby girls are born. One is born into the home of the tribal chief, Sheikh Shamikh, and his wife, Noof; the other is born to a poor woman named Sajaya. Because of a disfiguring burn, the midwife, Wasaif, secretly swaps the two babies, hiding the truth for years. Each girl grows up in a home that is not her own: Shamma lives a life of luxury, while Rahaf grows up in poverty. When the truth is finally revealed 17 years later, everyone's life is turned upside down. Both girls begin a quest to find their true identity: Who is the real mother? Who deserves the love? And what matters more—the bond of blood, or the warmth of affection?

metas.name: Please Save My Earth

As Arisu is drawn deeper into the mystery of her former existence, a young boy next door awakens to a past-life persona consumed by love for Mokuren. The intense passions and sins of their previous lives collide with the present, gradually revealing a shocking truth - and an unexpected connection between Arisu and Mokuren that binds their fates across lifetimes.

metas.name: Be Mine
metas.description: Pipim, who had the dream of opening a coffee shop with her girlfriend has her heart destroyed with the death of her beloved. However, Pipim, motivated by love, decides to open the business as a tribute to the woman who made her days happier and it is in this place that the four love stories of the "Be Mine" universe connect. For a long time, Tawan has harbored a strong sense of love for Winnie. Thanks to fate, they become roommates, and this closeness causes a more intense relationship than just friendship to develop between them. Pipim finds herself embroiled in a complicated situation due to her father's financial problems. Luckily, her friend Sitang introduces her to Peeraya, a businesswoman willing to help her. However, Peeraya sets a condition to help her: Pipim must pretend to be his girlfriend. Now, Pipim is faced with a choice that could change his life while dealing with the dilemmas of this relationship of appearances. Phapie works as an employee at P'Peak's coffee shop and is Pipim's sister. When her family struggles due to her father's legal troubles, Phapie makes the difficult decision to end her relationship with Jaokha, who is Jaojay's sister. She did this to protect Jaokha from the suffering that might arise because of the problems involving her relatives. Although the choice was painful, Phapie put Jaokha's well-being first by letting go of the relationship. Tawan's friend Jaojay joins Sitang's company as an intern. Initially, she only admires her, but over time, this feeling evolves into something deeper: love. However, they face the challenge of their remarkable age difference and the complexity of maintaining a romantic relationship in the workplace.
